rationale: ram_zeroshot-claude-agentic: val_n=20, seed=42, rationale=iter-13 (toward 20): ram_sigma 1e-2->2e-3 at blend=0.3/factor=0.7 (the 0.9393 ceiling). ONE knob = ram_sigma DOWN. Trend iter-11->12: ram_factor 0.7->0.5 flat (0.93847), ram_sigma 5e-3->1e-2 flat in SSIM (0.93886) but DROPPED PSNR 35.15->34.22 (over-denoising). blend (peak 0.3) and ram_factor (peak 0.7) are mapped+saturated; sigma UP hurt. Failure mode at 0.9393: RAM foreign denoiser over-smooths high-freq that LD-FBP already keeps -> structural ceiling, hr=0. Hypothesis: sigma DOWN to 2e-3 tells RAM the data is CLEANER -> lighter denoising -> preserves more detail; if SSIM/PSNR still flat-or-down, the sigma lever is exhausted in BOTH directions and RAM is confirmed structurally <LD-FBP. <2 min wall (val-only, ~100s)., ram_post_fbp_blend=0.3, ram_factor=0.7, ram_sigma=0.002
